description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Textarea that adjusts default attributes (cols and rows) for textarea HTML elements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Textarea
classes.description: A class that transforms HTML <textarea> attributes by setting default values for 'cols' and 'rows' if they are not already set.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Adjusts the 'cols' and 'rows' attributes of a <textarea> element to default values if they are not provided.
